The mathematical reviewer passed after source attestation, but the field score ceiling was 6.2 below 7.4, with no bounded salvage path and a presentation-only duplicate theorem still flagged. tldr: The single-assay triangular channel admits matched minimax MSE and uniformly honest connected-interval expected-length orders. For the causal median contrast on \(\mathcal C(\beta,q)\), and for pointwise CDF estimation on the published \(\mathcal W_{\beta,q}(20,100)\), RMSE and honest length have order \(n^{-(\beta+1)/(2\beta+5+\beta(3-q)_+/q)}\) away from \(q=3\), and \(\{\log(\mathrm e n)/n\}^{(\beta+1)/(2\beta+5)}\) at \(q=3\). MSE is the square of this order. Explicit finite inverse scores attain the bounds; legal odd alternatives with disjoint convolved-support scales prove that the critical logarithm is necessary. Causal identification is given separately. No firstness claim is made.
gap: Single-assay CDF estimation with zeros is occupied, while the inspected quantile theorems exclude the triangular channel. The same-channel density theory does not supply half-line displacement or honest median length, and its critical density logarithm is unmatched.
fill: The open kernel requires numerical regime formulas, a total estimator and connected honest interval, and median-specific testing alternatives for the entire class. Its full CDF companion distinguishes an integrated-functional calculation from a causal relabeling of density theory.
